title: Boutique retail plan
goal: Let a shopper understand the shopfront, merchandise displays, fitting rooms, checkout queue, and stock access before entering.

rubric.must: The entrance and two large shopfront windows are visibly arranged along the customer-facing wall.
Perimeter shelving and multiple freestanding island clothing racks are both clearly visible.
An enclosed fitting-room block visibly contains three separate fitting-room symbols.
The checkout counter has a labeled clear queue area that does not overlap any display fixture.
A labeled stockroom with shelving is visibly connected to the sales floor by a door.
Visible aisles remain around the display islands and provide a clear route from entrance to fitting rooms and checkout.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the floorplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The plan visibly shows the south-facing entrance between two shopfront windows, perimeter shelving and four freestanding clothing racks, three separate fitting rooms inside an enclosed block, and a labeled dashed checkout queue clear of fixtures. The stockroom is labeled, contains shelving, and connects to the sales floor by a door. Open circulation is visible between the display islands and toward checkout and fitting rooms; no material overlap or cropping is apparent.

items.evidence: Two windows and a centered entrance are visibly arranged along the south-facing wall.
Perimeter shelving runs along the left side, and four separate feature racks are visible in the sales floor.
The enclosed fitting-room block on the right contains three separately drawn, labeled try-on rooms.
The checkout counter and labeled dashed checkout queue area are distinct; the queue does not visibly overlap a display fixture.
The labeled stockroom at lower right contains two shelving rows and has a doorway connecting it to the sales floor.
Visible open aisles separate the four rack islands, with a clear route from the entrance through the sales floor toward checkout and the fitting-room doorway.
